segments.t: Outside Andréa's apartment building after dinner, Hicham gently probes Andréa about her pregnancy and future plans. Andréa feels conflicted about becoming a mother while managing top clients at the Cannes festival. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Merci pour ce très bon dîner, Hicham.
Je ne t'ai jamais vue manger autant!
Être avec toi m'ouvre l'appétit.
Ce n'est pas plutôt la grossesse?
Non, je ne crois pas vraiment.
Est-ce que j'ai beaucoup grossi?
Non, mais cette grossesse t'a changée.
Tu es plus calme et très rayonnante.
Mes seins ne sont pas très rayonnants!
Je reconnais bien ta rue maintenant.
Tu t'inquiètes pour le futur bébé?
Je ne sais pas ce que je ferai.
On se verra à mon retour de Cannes.
Let's examine Andréa and Hicham's intimate street conversation step by step to explore romantic ambiguity and parenthood.
Merci pour ce très bon dîner, Hicham.
'Thank you for this very good dinner, Hicham.' Andrea thanks him politely as they arrive outside her home.
Je ne t'ai jamais vue manger autant!
'I have never seen you eat so much!' Hicham teases her about clearing her plate with unusual gusto.
Être avec toi m'ouvre l'appétit.
'Being with you whets my appetite.' Andrea offers a playful excuse for eating heartily.
Ce n'est pas plutôt la grossesse?
'Is it not rather the pregnancy?' Hicham directly brings up her developing condition.
Non, je ne crois pas vraiment.
'No, I do not really think so.' Andrea avoids dwelling on medical symptoms.
Est-ce que j'ai beaucoup grossi?
'Have I gained a lot of weight?' Andrea checks self-consciously if physical changes are already obvious.
Non, mais cette grossesse t'a changée.
'No, but this pregnancy has changed you.' Hicham reassures her with affectionate honesty.
Tu es plus calme et très rayonnante.
'You are calmer and very radiant.' Hicham notices a softer and warmer demeanor in her.
Mes seins ne sont pas très rayonnants!
'My breasts are not very radiant!' Andrea jokes about the uncomfortable physical transformations.
Je reconnais bien ta rue maintenant.
'I recognize your street well now.' Hicham recalls past visits to her apartment block.
Tu t'inquiètes pour le futur bébé?
'Are you worried about the future baby?' Hicham asks if she feels anxious about impending motherhood.
Je ne sais pas ce que je ferai.
'I do not know what I will do.' Andrea confesses her deep uncertainty about the road ahead.
On se verra à mon retour de Cannes.
'We will see each other on my return from Cannes.' Andrea defers major life decisions until after the festival. Now let's listen to the scene once more from start to finish.

Hicham and Andréa share a tender moment on the Parisian pavement as pregnancy forces Andréa to reconsider her priorities before Cannes. See you next time!
À bientôt!
